definition_zh: 船体；船身；外壳；外皮；豆荚；去壳；剥去果皮
definition_en: the main body or frame of a ship, or the outer covering of a seed, nut or fruit; also to remove such a covering
core_image: 船身像半个空壳漂在水上，只剩龙骨与舷侧撑开一副外壳
scene: 打捞队把沉船的船身拖出海面，海水从破洞里哗哗流下。Divers hauled the heavy hull of the sunken boat up to the surface.
sceneCN: 这里 hull 是「船体」（第 1 个义项：船的主要躯壳，不含桅杆与索具）；句意：潜水员把沉船的沉重船体拖到水面。画面重点：龙骨、舷侧、流下的海水。

pos.zh: 船体；船身；外壳；外皮；豆荚
去壳；剥皮；去果皮

derivatives.zh: hull 加 -ing 作名词，指去壳、脱壳这道工序，如 rice hulling 稻谷脱壳
hull 加 -ed 作形容词，指「已去壳的」，如 hulled barley 去壳大麦
hull 加表器具的后缀 -er，指脱壳机、去壳器
hull 加 -less 构成，指「无壳的、不带外壳的」

senses.title: The body of a ship
senses.definition: the main frame or body of a ship or boat, without the masts or rigging
senses.definitionCN: 船的主体框架与躯壳，不包括桅杆和索具
senses.example: The wooden hull was patched with new planks.
senses.exampleCN: 木船体用新木板补好了。
senses.why: The oldest meaning is the hollow body that keeps a boat afloat, so the first picture is a shell riding the water.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的含义就是让船浮起来的那个空壳船身，所以第一个画面是漂在水面上的外壳。

senses.title: The outer part of a vessel
senses.definition: the outer plating of a ship, seen from the water or from the outside
senses.definitionCN: 船舶的外层船壳板，从水面或船外看到的那一面
senses.example: Barnacles covered the hull below the waterline.
senses.exampleCN: 水线以下的船壳上爬满了藤壶。
senses.why: Painters and divers see only the outside of the body, so the frame is named again by its outer skin.
senses.whyCN: 漆工与潜水员打交道的是躯壳的外面，于是「船身」又用来专指它的外层皮肤。

senses.title: The outer covering of a seed or fruit
senses.definition: the tough outer rind, pod or husk of a fruit, seed or nut
senses.definitionCN: 果实、种子或坚果坚硬的外层果皮、荚壳
senses.example: Popcorn is made from corn whose hull bursts open.
senses.exampleCN: 爆米花是用外壳爆开的玉米做的。
senses.why: A pod or husk is a shell around a soft inside, the same shape as a boat body around its empty hold, so the word moves to plants.
senses.whyCN: 豆荚与谷壳就是包着软内容的一层壳，形状和包住空舱的船身一样，因此这个词自然迁移到植物上。

senses.title: To remove a hull
senses.definition: to take off the shell or husk of peas, beans, seeds or nuts
senses.definitionCN: 把豌豆、豆类、种子或坚果的外壳剥掉
senses.example: They were hulling fresh peas at the kitchen table.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在餐桌边剥新鲜豌豆。
senses.why: If the covering is called a hull, then taking it off is to hull, a direct verb from the noun.
senses.whyCN: 既然那层皮叫 hull，把皮去掉就是 hull，这是由名词直接转成的动词。

senses.title: A light airship body
senses.definition: the main gas bag or car body of an airship or balloon
senses.definitionCN: 飞艇或气球的主要气囊与吊舱主体
senses.example: Engineers checked the airship hull for leaks.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师检查了飞艇艇身有没有漏气。
senses.why: An airship repeats the boat image in the sky: one big hollow body that holds everything else.
senses.whyCN: 飞艇把船的画面搬到了天上：同样是一个承载其他一切的大空壳，于是船体的名字被借了下来。

intro.en: Hull has two histories: the boat body grows from an old English word for a hollow shell, while the plant covering follows a related shape.
intro.cn: hull 有两条线索：船体义来自英语里表示「空壳」的古老词，而果壳义则顺着同一个形状延伸。

items.en: The word is recorded as hulu, meaning a husk or a shell, and it is native Germanic.
items.cn: 古英语记录作 hulu，意为谷壳或外壳，属于本土日耳曼词。

items.en: Hull is applied to the hollow body of a ship in the Middle English period.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，hull 开始用来指船的空心船身。

items.en: Shipbuilders describe the bare body of a vessel before the fittings go on as the hull.
items.cn: 造船者在装配之前，把光秃的船身称为 hull。

items.en: The verb to hull, to strip off the husk, becomes current in farming and food work.
items.cn: 十七世纪，去皮去壳的动词用法在农事与食物加工中流行起来。

items.en: Modern English uses hull for ships, airships, seeds, and for tanks and planes in military talk.
items.cn: 现代英语里 hull 指船、飞艇、种子外壳，军事中也可指坦克与飞机的主体。

note.en: Hull sits between words for vessels and words for shells, so it is close to husk and pod for plants and to deck and keel for ships.
note.cn: hull 处在「船」与「壳」两组词之间，在植物里与 husk、pod 相邻，在船词汇里与 keel 相邻。

entries.definition: having the outer covering removed
entries.definitionCN: hull 的过去式与形容词，指已去壳的

entries.definition: a machine that removes husks
entries.definitionCN: hull 加 -er 的派生词，指脱壳机

entries.definition: a large old ship, or its empty body
entries.definitionCN: 废船；船的空壳；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the dry outer covering of grain or seeds
entries.definitionCN: 谷壳；干外皮，与植物义的 hull 最近

entries.definition: the long case holding the seeds of a plant
entries.definitionCN: 豆荚，与豆类外壳义相同

entries.definition: the long central piece along the bottom of a ship
entries.definitionCN: 龙骨，船体最底部的主龙骨，常与 hull 一词并用

normalIntro.en: Hull means one thing with two faces: a hollow shell, whether it floats or holds a seed.
normalIntro.cn: hull 只有一个意思，却有两张脸：一个空壳，不管它是浮在水上的还是包着种子的。

normal.en: A steel hull is the bare body of a ship, with no masts or rigging.
normal.cn: steel hull 指不带桅杆索具的光船身。

normal.en: To hull peas is to strip them from their pods.
normal.cn: to hull peas 就是把豌豆从豆荚里剥出来。

normal.en: Rice hull is the hard covering that protects the grain.
normal.cn: rice hull 是保护谷粒的硬壳。

normal.en: Words like skulk and hulk share the -ulk shape but not the history.
normal.cn: skulk、hulk 与 hull 形状相近，但没有共同的来历。

normal.en: The noun becomes a verb without change of spelling: the hull is what you hull off.
normal.cn: 名词不动拼写就变成动词：被剥掉的那层壳就是 hull。

abstract.en: Picture a bare brown shell of a boat rocking on grey water.
abstract.cn: 想象一只只剩棕色空壳的船在灰水面上晃。

abstract.en: Picture the tight green case that keeps a pea safe inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一层紧裹的绿色外皮让豌豆安睡在里面。

abstract.en: Hear the crackle as a dry husk splits between thumb and finger.
abstract.cn: 想象干燥的谷壳在拇指与食指之间裂开时的脆响。

examples.en: The hull of the fishing boat was covered in green weed.
examples.cn: 渔船船身布满绿藻。

examples.en: Farmers hull the rice before it goes to the market.
examples.cn: 稻谷在运往市场前要由农民脱壳。

examples.en: The airship hull was repaired after the storm.
examples.cn: 风暴过后，飞艇艇身得到了修补。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈壳」——哈一口气就能剥开的壳，也像船身那层空壳。这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 hulu（谷壳、外壳）系本土日耳曼词，核心义「一层包住内部空腔的硬壳」；中古英语时期这层「壳」被比作船的空心躯壳，于是 hull 指船体，再由名词转为动词「去壳」。这个词不是来自拉丁语，与拉丁语并无直接派生关系。

sensesIntro.en: Hull began as a hollow shell, moved to the body of a boat, then to any outer covering, and finally to the act of stripping that covering off.
sensesIntro.cn: hull 最初指一个空壳，随后移到船的躯壳上，再扩展到任何外壳，最后转成剥掉外壳的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hollow shell that holds something, a ship body or a seed case.
core.cn: 核心意象：包住某物的空心壳，可以是船身，也可以是包着种子的壳。

branches.en: The hollow body of a ship is the nautical core.
branches.cn: 中空的船身是航海义的核心。

branches.en: The outer plating is the same body seen from outside.
branches.cn: 外层船壳是同一个躯壳从外面看到的样子。

branches.en: A seed case repeats the shell shape in plants.
branches.cn: 种子外壳在植物界重复了同一个壳体形状。

branches.en: Naming the case gives a verb for taking it off.
branches.cn: 给外壳命名之后，就有了剥掉它的动词。

branches.en: An airship borrows the boat body for the sky.
branches.cn: 飞艇把船身借到了天上。

intro.en: Hull is a short native word; its family forms with -ed, -ing, -er and -less rather than with Latin prefixes.
intro.cn: hull 是简短的本土词，它的词族靠 -ed、-ing、-er、-less 构成，而不是靠拉丁前缀。

latinIntro.en: Hull has no reliable Latin ancestor, so these Latin words are listed only as comparisons for shells and vessels.
latinIntro.cn: hull 没有可靠的拉丁语祖先，下列拉丁词只作「壳」与「容器」的对照。

items.example: The hull rose with the tide.
items.exampleCN: 船身随潮水升起。

items.meaningCN: 复数；动词第三人称单数
items.example: Both hulls were painted grey.
items.exampleCN: 两只船身都漆成了灰色。

items.example: Hulled barley cooks faster.
items.exampleCN: 去壳大麦更容易煮烂。

items.example: Hulling the rice took all morning.
items.exampleCN: 稻谷脱壳花了一上午。

items.example: The suffix -er forms huller.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 huller。

items.example: The huller runs on a small motor.
items.exampleCN: 脱壳机由一台小马达带动。

items.example: The suffix -less forms hulless.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -less 构成 hulless。

items.example: Hulless oats drop their seed coats easily.
items.exampleCN: 无壳燕麦的种皮很容易脱落。

definition_zh: 哼唱；闭着嘴哼曲子；发出嗡嗡声；持续轰鸣；忙碌活跃；哼声；嗡嗡声；一种低声的赞同
definition_en: to make a low steady sound with the lips closed, or for a machine or insect to make such a sound; also the sound itself
core_image: 闭着嘴、双唇微颤，一条低低的声线不断延续
scene: 厨房里，母亲一边剥豆子，一边轻轻哼着儿歌，声音低得几乎听不见。Mother hums an old tune as she peels the beans.
sceneCN: 这里 hum 是「哼唱」（第 1 个义项：闭着嘴唇哼出调子）；句意：母亲一边剥豆子，一边哼着一支旧曲子。画面重点：闭着的嘴、微颤的唇、低低不断的声音。

pos.zh: 哼唱；发出嗡嗡声；轰鸣；忙碌活跃
哼声；嗡嗡声；持续的低响

derivatives.zh: hum 加 -ing 作形容词，指「持续嗡嗡作响的」，也可作名词指哼唱，如 humming noise 嗡嗡声
hum 加表人或器具的后缀 -er，指哼唱者或发出嗡嗡声的装置
humming 与 bird 复合，指蜂鸟，因翅膀振动发出嗡嗡声而得名

senses.title: To sing with the lips closed
senses.definition: to sing a tune with the lips closed, producing a soft sound
senses.definitionCN: 闭着嘴唇哼出曲调，发出柔和的声音
senses.example: She hummed a lullaby while folding the washing.
senses.exampleCN: 她一边叠衣服，一边哼着摇篮曲。
senses.why: The base sense is the sound of the organs of speech with the mouth shut, so the first picture is a tune with no words.
senses.whyCN: 最基本的含义就是闭着嘴时口腔发出的那种声音，所以第一个画面是有调子却没有词的哼唱。

senses.title: To make a low continuous noise
senses.definition: to make a low steady sound like that of a bee or a running engine
senses.definitionCN: 发出像蜜蜂或运转的发动机那样低而稳定的声音
senses.example: A small fan hummed in the corner of the room.
senses.exampleCN: 房间角落里一台小风扇嗡嗡地响着。
senses.why: A bee and an engine produce the same flat band of sound as a closed mouth, so objects inherit the verb for humming.
senses.whyCN: 蜜蜂和发动机发出的，与闭着嘴哼唱是同样一条平稳的声音带，于是这个动词也用到了物体身上。

senses.title: To be very busy
senses.definition: of a place, to be full of activity and continuous noise
senses.definitionCN: 指某地充满活动与持续不断的声响
senses.example: The market hummed with people before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 天亮前的集市已经人声鼎沸。
senses.why: A busy crowd always makes a low blended noise, so a humming place comes to mean a lively, working place.
senses.whyCN: 繁忙的人群总会汇成一片低低的嗡响，因此「嗡嗡作响的地方」自然引申为热闹有生气、在运转的地方。

senses.title: To make progress well
senses.definition: of a machine, system or activity, to run smoothly and steadily
senses.definitionCN: 指机器、系统或活动平稳顺畅地运转
senses.example: The old truck was humming along the coast road.
senses.exampleCN: 旧卡车沿着海边公路稳稳地开动着。
senses.why: A steady hum is the sound of a well-tuned engine, so humming becomes a sign that everything is going right.
senses.whyCN: 平稳的嗡响是发动机状态良好的声音，于是「在哼响」变成了「一切运转顺利」的可靠信号。

senses.title: The sound itself
senses.definition: a low steady sound, whether human, mechanical or natural
senses.definitionCN: 低而持续的声音，可以来自人、机器或自然
senses.example: The hum of the city kept him awake.
senses.exampleCN: 城市的嗡嗡声让他睡不着。
senses.why: Every action has a name, so the verb hum gives the noun a hum for the sound it makes.
senses.whyCN: 有动作就有名称，于是动词 hum 顺理成章地变成名词，专指它发出的那串声音。

senses.title: To show agreement quietly
senses.definition: to answer with a low sound that shows agreement, doubt or interest
senses.definitionCN: 用一声低音表示同意、疑虑或兴趣
senses.example: He hummed in agreement before the speaker went on.
senses.exampleCN: 发言人继续之前，他嗯了一声表示同意。
senses.why: A closed-mouth sound is a social signal too, so the humming noise becomes a small human response between speakers.
senses.whyCN: 闭着嘴发出的声音也是社交信号，于是这种哼声成了对话双方之间一种小小的回应。

intro.en: Hum is an imitative word, first a sound imagined in writing, then a verb and a noun for that low steady noise.
intro.cn: hum 是一个拟声词，最初只是在文字里模仿声音，后来才成为描述这种低而持续声响的动词与名词。

items.en: The word copies a closed-mouth, low, steady sound and has no Latin root.
items.cn: 这个词是模仿闭着嘴发出的低而稳定的声音造出来的，没有拉丁词根。

items.en: A form close to humme is recorded in the Middle English period, mainly for a low sound.
items.cn: 中古英语时期记录到接近 humme 的形式，主要指低低的声音。

items.en: Hum is used for the low sound of a bee or an engine as well as for singing.
items.cn: 十六世纪，hum 既用于哼唱，也用于蜜蜂或机器的低响。

items.en: The much older hum our is rewritten as hum a tune, and humming becomes a common pastime.
items.cn: 更早的 hum our 被改写为 hum a tune，哼唱成了常见的消遣。

items.en: Modern English adds the busy-place sense, as in the office hums with activity.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「地方忙碌活跃」的用法，如办公室一片繁忙。

note.en: Hum belongs to the group of low continuous sounds, next to buzz, drone and murmur, and a few words share its spelling shape.
note.cn: hum 属于「低而持续的声音」这一组，与 buzz、drone、murmur 相邻，另外还有些词与它拼写相近。

entries.definition: past form of the verb to hum
entries.definitionCN: hum 的过去式与过去分词

entries.definition: the act or sound of humming
entries.definitionCN: hum 加 -ing，指哼唱或嗡嗡作响

entries.definition: a small bird that hovers with a humming sound
entries.definitionCN: 蜂鸟，由 humming 与 bird 复合而成

entries.definition: a low rough sound like that of a bee
a low dull continuous sound
a soft low continuous sound of voices or water
entries.definitionCN: 低语声；低沉连续的轻声

normalIntro.en: Hum is one smooth line of sound made in the mouth with the lips shut or captured from any steady machine.
normalIntro.cn: hum 就是一条平滑的声音线：或由闭着的嘴发出，或来自任何平稳运转的机器。

normal.en: Hum a tune means to sing it with the lips closed.
normal.cn: hum a tune 就是闭着嘴把调子唱出来。

normal.en: The final consonant is doubled before -ed and -ing: hummed, humming.
normal.cn: 在 -ed 与 -ing 之前，词尾辅音要双写：hummed、humming。

normal.en: Hum with activity paints a busy place by its sound rather than its look.
normal.cn: hum with activity 用声音而不是画面来描写一个繁忙的地方。

normal.en: The noun is spelled exactly like the verb, so a hum is simply the sound it names.
normal.cn: 名词与动词拼写完全相同，一个 hum 就是它所指的那种声音。

normal.en: Compare buzz for insects and murmur for voices; hum covers both but stays smooth.
normal.cn: 对比昆虫的 buzz 与人声的 murmur，hum 两者都能用，但始终是平顺的。

abstract.en: Picture a child with lips pressed together, head tilted, one note going on and on.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子抿着双唇，歪着头，一个音一直绵延下去。

abstract.en: Listen to the flat band of a fridge motor behind a quiet kitchen wall.
abstract.cn: 想象安静厨房的墙后，冰箱马达那一层平板般的声音。

abstract.en: Feel the whole street blending into one steady tone at rush hour.
abstract.cn: 想象高峰时段整条街汇成一条稳定的低音。

examples.en: He hums to himself when he is thinking hard.
examples.cn: 他苦苦思考时会自顾自地哼唱。

examples.en: The factory gate hummed with workers at six in the morning.
examples.cn: 清晨六点，工厂门口工人往来，一片繁忙。

examples.en: We heard the faint hum of bees among the flowers.
examples.cn: 我们听到花丛中蜜蜂微弱的嗡嗡声。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈姆」——嘴巴一合，喉咙里就滚出一条停不下来的哼哼；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: hum 是拟声词，直接模仿闭着嘴发出的低而不间断的声音，没有可追溯的拉丁或日耳曼词根；中古英语时期已有接近 humme 的形式，核心义「一条平稳持续的低音」，由人声扩展到机器、自然与繁忙之地。

sensesIntro.en: Hum starts as a closed-mouth tune, spreads to any steady low machine or insect sound, then to busy places and smoothly running things, and finally becomes the noun for that sound.
sensesIntro.cn: hum 从闭着嘴哼出的调子开始，扩展到机器或昆虫平稳的低响，再到忙碌的地方与顺畅运转的事物，最后成为这种声音本身的名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one low even thread of sound, lips closed or engine running.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条低而均匀的声音线，或出自闭着的嘴，或出自运转的机器。

branches.en: A wordless tune through closed lips is the source sense.
branches.cn: 闭着嘴哼出的无词调子是本义。

branches.en: Bees and machines copy the same continuous band of sound.
branches.cn: 蜜蜂与机器复制了同一条连续的声音带。

branches.en: A lively crowd blends its voices into that band.
branches.cn: 热闹的人群把人声融进了这条声带。

branches.en: A smooth-running engine hums, so work that goes well hums along.
branches.cn: 运转顺畅的发动机在哼响，因此顺利的工作也说在哼响。

branches.en: The sound becomes a noun, and a short closed-mouth sound also answers a speaker.
branches.cn: 声音本身成了名词，而闭着嘴的一声短音也成为对说话人的回应。

intro.en: Hum has no Latin parts; its family grows with -er, -ing and compounding, and its spelling doubles the final m.
intro.cn: hum 没有拉丁语构件，它的词族靠 -er、-ing 与复合构词扩展，拼写时词尾的 m 要双写。

latinIntro.en: Hum is imitative and has no Latin ancestor, so the Latin entries here are only compared for sound words.
latinIntro.cn: hum 是拟声词，没有拉丁语祖先，这里列出的拉丁词仅在「声音」这一意义上作对照。

items.example: She likes to hum while she works.
items.exampleCN: 她喜欢在工作时哼唱。

items.example: The fan hums all night.
items.exampleCN: 风扇整夜嗡嗡响。

items.example: The children hummed the same song.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们哼着同一首歌。

items.meaning: the act or sound of humming
items.example: Humming helped her fall asleep.
items.exampleCN: 哼唱帮她睡着了。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或持续状态的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing forms humming.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 humming。

items.meaning: one who does, or a device
items.example: The suffix -er forms hummer.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 hummer。

items.example: Distant hums mixed in the night air.
items.exampleCN: 远处各种低响混在夜色里。

items.example: A hummingbird hovered by the red flower.
items.exampleCN: 一只蜂鸟悬停在红花旁。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 低而持续的声音，对照用

latinEntries.meaning: a buzzing sound, also a bee

definition_zh: 仁慈的；人道的；体谅的；善待动物的
definition_en: kind, gentle, and showing care for the suffering of people or animals
core_image: 一双手轻轻扶住受伤的小动物，动作放得很慢
scene: 雨后的巷口，一位老人蹲下身子，把受伤的流浪猫裹进外套。The humane thing to do was to call a vet and wait with the animal.
sceneCN: 这里 humane 是「仁慈的、人道的」（第 1 个义项：以同情与善意对待人与动物的品质）；句意：人道的做法是叫兽医来，并陪着这只动物等候。画面焦点：弯下的身影、裹住猫的外套、慢慢移动的手。

pos.zh: 仁慈的；人道的；体谅的；善待动物的

derivatives.zh: 人道地；以仁慈的方式
人道；仁慈
人性；人道；人类
人的；人类（与 humane 同源但意义分开）

senses.title: Kind and caring toward people
senses.definition: showing kindness and consideration for other people, especially those who are weak or in difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 对他人，尤其对弱小或处境困难的人，表现出善意与顾及
senses.example: It was a humane decision to let the old worker retire early with full pay.
senses.exampleCN: 让这位老工人带全薪提前退休，是个人道的决定。
senses.why: The Latin adjective meant of human nature, and kindness was seen as the best part of that nature, so humane drifted toward merciful.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语形容词本义是「属于人的本性的」，而善良被视为人性中最好的部分，所以 humane 逐渐偏向「仁慈」。

senses.title: Avoiding cruelty to animals
senses.definition: treating animals without unnecessary cruelty or suffering
senses.definitionCN: 以不带来不必要痛苦的方式对待动物
senses.example: The shelter insists on humane methods of catching stray dogs.
senses.exampleCN: 收容站坚持用人道的方式捕捉流浪狗。
senses.why: Because animals are thought of as our fellow creatures, the kind-to-people sense extends naturally to how we treat them.
senses.whyCN: 因为动物被看作与我们同为生灵，这个「待人以善」的含义自然延伸到我们如何对待它们。

senses.title: A civilized way of doing something
senses.titleCN: 文明人道的（做法或制度）
senses.definition: describing a system, policy, or method that respects human dignity instead of force or fear
senses.definitionCN: 形容尊重人的尊严，而非以残酷手段行事的制度、政策或方法
senses.example: Prison reform groups call for more humane conditions in overcrowded cells.
senses.exampleCN: 监狱改革团体呼吁改善过度拥挤牢房里的人道条件。
senses.why: Institution talk turns the personal virtue into a standard that whole systems are judged by, contrastive with harsh or degrading treatment.
senses.whyCN: 制度层面的话语把个人美德变成衡量整套体系的标准，常与苛刻、有辱人格的对待形成对照。

intro.en: Humane entered English as a spelling of human, and only later split off as a separate adjective meaning kind or merciful.
intro.cn: humane 进入英语时本是 human 的另一种拼法，后来才分出来，专表「仁慈、宽厚」。

items.en: Humanus, from homo, means belonging to a human being, and also cultured or kind.
items.cn: 拉丁语 humanus 源自 homo（人），意为属于人的，也含「有教养、和善」之意。

items.en: The abstract noun humanitas gathers good breeding, learning, and mercy in one word.
items.cn: 抽象名词 humanitas 把教养、学问与仁慈集于一体。

items.en: Humain passes the word into French with both the belonging-to-man and the kind senses.
items.cn: humain 把这个词带入法语，同时保留了「属于人」与「和善」两层意思。

items.en: Human and humane were long used as two spellings of the same word.
items.cn: human 与 humane 曾长期只是同一个词的两写法。

items.en: Around the 18th century humane settles on kind and merciful, especially toward the weak and toward animals.
items.cn: 约在十八世纪，humane 固定为「仁慈、宽厚」，尤指对弱者与动物。

items.en: Modern usage also applies it to methods and conditions judged by mercy and dignity.
items.cn: 现代用法还把它用于以仁慈与尊严来衡量做法和条件。

note.en: Humane is a human word: it voices the kind part of our nature and reaches out to other creatures.
note.cn: humane 是一个「人」的词：它说出人性中善良的一面，并把这份善意延伸到其他生灵。

entries.definition: relating to people
the human race or kindness toward others
subjects about human culture
caring and gentle toward others
showing sympathy for suffering
willing to forgive or spare from pain

normalIntro.en: Humane keeps the human in it: humanity plus a kind heart. On the page it is only one letter away from human.
normalIntro.cn: humane 保留着 human（人）的影子：人性加一颗善心；在书面上只与 human 差一个字母。

normal.en: Replace the final e with human and you get human, the base of the whole family.
normal.cn: 把末尾的 e 换掉就是 human，它正是整个词族的词基。

normal.en: The suffix -e is a fake suffix: humans add it to keep the adjective, so do not read it as an affix.
normal.cn: 词尾 -e 不是真词缀：只是为了让 humane 与 human 区分开，不能当作构词成分来读。

normal.en: Humane treatment is the collocation you meet most often in ethics and law texts.
normal.cn: humane treatment 是伦理与法律文本里最常见的搭配。

normal.en: Humane society usually means an animal protection group, not a human one.
normal.cn: humane society 通常指动物保护协会，而不是关于人的社团。

normal.en: Compare kind and humane: kind is a warm everyday word, humane is a formal word about dignity and cruelty.
normal.cn: 对比 kind 与 humane：kind 是温暖的日常词，humane 是谈尊严与残酷与否的正式词。

abstract.en: Picture hands lifting a small animal more slowly than usual.
abstract.cn: 想象一双手抬起一只小动物，动作比平时放得更慢。

abstract.en: Think of a judge who looks at the person behind the rules.
abstract.cn: 想象一位法官，在规则之外看见规则背后的那个人。

abstract.en: Imagine an open door marked kindness in the root human.
abstract.cn: 想象 human 这个词根上开着一扇写着善良的门。

examples.en: The prison was praised for its humane treatment of elderly inmates.
examples.cn: 这座监狱因对老年囚犯的人道对待而受到称赞。

examples.en: People argued for a more humane way to reduce the pigeon population.
examples.cn: 人们主张用更人道的方式来减少鸽子的数量。

examples.en: Stray cats are caught by humane traps and then taken to a shelter.
examples.cn: 流浪猫被人道的捕猫笼捉住，然后送到收容所。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休养」——受伤的动物被小心地养护起来，就是 humane 的仁慈；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 homo（人）→ humanus（人的；有教养的和善）→ 古法语 humain → 英语 human、humane 两种拼法并存 → 十八世纪后 humane 专指「仁慈的、人道的」。

sensesIntro.en: Humane begins as a kind of people and widens: from being gentle with people, to sparing animals, and finally to judging whole systems by dignity.
sensesIntro.cn: humane 从「属于人」出发不断扩大：先指待人和善，再指不虐待动物，最后指以尊严来衡量整套制度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that slows down so a frightened animal can trust it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手放慢速度，让受惊的动物愿意相信它。

branches.en: Kindness toward people is the personal sense.
branches.cn: 待人以善是个人层面的义项。

branches.en: Not hurting animals is the same kindness across species.
branches.cn: 不伤害动物是把同一份善意延伸到其他物种。

branches.en: Humane policy is that kindness written into institutions.
branches.cn: 人道的政策是把这份善意写进制度里。

branches.en: A person and a system are judged by the same standard of not causing needless suffering.
branches.cn: 人和制度被同一把尺子衡量：是否制造了不必要的痛苦。

branches.en: Animal shelters and prison reform share the same argument against cruelty.
branches.cn: 动物收容与监狱改革用的是同一套反对残忍的理由。

intro.en: Humane is the human word with a heart: it is built on the Latin root that gives human, humanity, and the humanities.
intro.cn: humane 是「带着心的人」这个词：它建立在提供 human、humanity 与人文学科的拉丁词根之上。

latinIntro.en: Latin humanus comes from homo, a human being, and humanitas gathers culture, learning, and kindness.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 humanus 源自 homo（人），humanitas 则汇聚了文化、学问与仁慈。

items.example: Homo is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: homo 是整个词族的源头。

items.example: Humanus carries both the people sense and the mercy sense.
items.exampleCN: humanus 兼有「人的」与「仁慈的」两层。

items.example: Humanitas joins learning with mercy.
items.exampleCN: humanitas 把学问与仁慈连在一起。

items.example: Humain transmits the word to French.
items.exampleCN: humain 把词传给法语。

items.example: Human is the spelling that keeps the people sense.
items.exampleCN: human 保留了「属于人」的含义。

items.example: Humane takes -ly to become an adverb.
items.exampleCN: humane 加 -ly 变成副词。

items.example: The suffix -ly turns humane into humanely.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 把 humane 变成 humanely。

items.example: Humane takes -ness for its noun form.
items.exampleCN: humane 加 -ness 构成名词。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms humaneness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 构成 humaneness。

definition_zh: 人文主义的；人本主义的；关注人的价值的
definition_en: believing in the value of people, human reason, and human culture rather than in the divine or the purely technical
core_image: 一架天平上，一边放着人，另一边放着机器
scene: 教材改版时，编辑主张减少技能训练，多留些讨论人生意义的内容。The school adopted a humanistic curriculum that puts students and their questions first.
sceneCN: 这里 humanistic 是「人文主义的」（第 2 个义项：强调人的价值、理性与文化的教育与思想立场）；句意：这所学校采用了一套以人为本的课程，把学生和他们的问题放在首位。画面焦点：天平上的人与机器、被翻开的旧课本。

pos.zh: 人文主义的；人本主义的；关注人的价值的

derivatives.zh: 人文主义；人本主义
人文主义者；人文主义的
人性；人类
人道地

senses.title: Believing in human dignity and reason
senses.definition: holding that human beings can find meaning and truth through reason and experience, without relying on supernatural authority
senses.definitionCN: 认为人可以通过理性与经验找到意义与真理，而不依赖超自然的权威
senses.example: Humanistic thinkers of the Renaissance trusted human reason above old doctrines.
senses.exampleCN: 文艺复兴时期的人本主义思想家信任人的理性胜过旧教条。
senses.why: The noun humanist named a scholar trained in the classical humanities, and the adjective humanistic grew out of that stance about human capacity.
senses.whyCN: 名词 humanist 原指受过古典人文教育的学者，形容词 humanistic 正是从这种对人的能力的态度中长出来的。

senses.title: Stressing human values in study and art
senses.titleCN: 人文主义的（学问与教育立场）
senses.definition: stressing the value of human culture, history, and literature in education and scholarship
senses.definitionCN: 在教育与研究中强调人类文化、历史与文学价值的
senses.example: The department offers a humanistic study of medieval poetry.
senses.exampleCN: 这个系提供了一项从中世纪诗歌出发的人文研究。
senses.why: Because the humanities are the fields that study human culture, humanistic came to describe scholarship that keeps those values central.
senses.whyCN: 因为人文学科正是研究人类文化的领域，humanistic 便用来形容把这些价值置于中心的学问。

senses.title: Putting the student at the centre
senses.titleCN: 以人为本的（方法或制度）
senses.definition: describing a method or system that treats personal growth and feeling as the main goal
senses.definitionCN: 把个人成长与感受视为主要目标的方法或制度
senses.example: Humanistic psychology insists that each client is the expert on their own life.
senses.exampleCN: 人本主义心理学坚持认为，每位来谈者才是自己生活的专家。
senses.why: In psychology and education the word is applied to methods that start from the person rather than from behaviour or test scores.
senses.whyCN: 在心理学与教育学中，这个词用来指从人本身出发、而不是从行为或分数出发的方法。

intro.en: Humanistic comes from humanist, which first named a student of the Latin and Greek classics.
intro.cn: humanistic 来自 humanist，起初指研习拉丁与希腊古典的作者。

items.en: Humanus and humanitas supply the root idea of human culture and humane learning.
items.cn: humanus 与 humanitas 提供了「人类文化与人文教养」的词根观念。

items.en: Humanista names a teacher of the classical humanities, and the word spreads from Italian universities.
items.cn: humanista 指教授古典人文学科的教师，这个词从意大利大学向外流传。

items.en: Humanist enters English for a scholar of classical letters.
items.cn: 十六世纪 humanist 进入英语，指古典文献学者。

items.en: Humanism names the movement that puts human reason and worth at the centre.
items.cn: 十九世纪 humanism 指以人的理性与价值为中心的思想运动。

items.en: The adjective humanistic adds -istic and covers traditions, education, and psychology.
items.cn: 现代英语由 humanism 加 -istic 构成 humanistic，涵盖传统、教育与心理学。

note.en: Humanistic belongs to the same human family as humane: both ask what honours the human being, one in ethics, one in thought and study.
note.cn: humanistic 与 humane 同属 human 家族：一个在伦理上、一个在思想与学问上追问「什么才是尊重人的」。

entries.definition: a supporter of humanism
a belief centred on human values
literature, history, and philosophy
focused on people and their needs
broad in the arts and open-minded
not tied to religion

normalIntro.en: Humanistic wears the human root like a flag and adds the -istic label of a belief or school.
normalIntro.cn: humanistic 把 human 这个词根当作旗帜，再加上表示「信条或学派」的 -istic。

normal.en: Strip -istic and you get humanist, the person who holds the belief.
normal.cn: 去掉 -istic 就是 humanist，指持有这种信念的人。

normal.en: The -istic ending signals a belief or a school, as in artistic and realistic.
normal.cn: 词尾 -istic 表示一种信念或流派，如同 artistic 与 realistic。

normal.en: Humanistic psychology is a well-known field where the word appears most.
normal.cn: humanistic psychology 是这个词出现最多、也最知名的领域。

normal.en: Contrast scientific and humanistic: scientific is about measurement, humanistic is about meaning.
normal.cn: 对比 scientific 与 humanistic：前者关乎测量，后者关乎意义。

normal.en: The humanities are the subjects that a humanistic education keeps central.
normal.cn: the humanities 是 humanistic 教育始终置于中心的学科。

abstract.en: Picture a scale with a person on one pan and a machine on the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，一边托盘放着人，另一边放着机器。

abstract.en: Think of a classroom where students ask why before what.
abstract.cn: 想象一间先问「为什么」再问「是什么」的教室。

abstract.en: Imagine the root human carrying a light toward old books.
abstract.cn: 想象 human 这个词根提着一盏灯，走向旧书堆。

examples.en: The essay defends a humanistic view of medicine, where the patient matters as much as the test.
examples.cn: 这篇文章为一种人性化的医学观辩护，认为病人与检查同样重要。

examples.en: She chose a humanistic course that mixes history, art, and ethics.
examples.cn: 她选了一门融合历史、艺术与伦理的人文课程。

examples.en: Humanistic education aims to help people understand themselves and others.
examples.cn: 人文主义教育旨在帮助人们理解自己与他人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休曼尼斯蒂克」——休养、曼妙、尼斯、蒂克，一串音符般的人文史；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 humanus（人的）→ humanitas（人性、人文教养）→ 文艺复兴 humanista（人文学者）→ 英语 humanist → humanism → 加 -istic 构成 humanistic。

sensesIntro.en: Humanistic moves from the classics to the classroom to the clinic: it first describes a scholar, then an education, then a way of treating people.
sensesIntro.cn: humanistic 从古典走向教室，再走向诊室：先形容学者，再形容教育，最后形容对待人的方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale where the human being is never outweighed by the machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架永远不让机器压过人的天平。

branches.en: The belief sense is the starting point of the word.
branches.cn: 信念层面的义项是这个词的起点。

branches.en: Scholarship in human culture is the documentary sense.
branches.cn: 人类文化研究是学科层面的义项。

branches.en: A person-centred method is the applied sense.
branches.cn: 以人为本的方法是应用层面的义项。

branches.en: A humanistic outlook shaped the study of the classics.
branches.cn: 人本主义的世界观塑造了古典学的研究。

branches.en: Therapists who trust the client echo the humanistic belief in reason and worth.
branches.cn: 信任来谈者的治疗师，与 humanistic 对人的理性与价值的信念相呼应。

intro.en: Humanistic is built on the same Latin root as human: humanus, then humanity, humanism, humanist, and finally humanistic.
intro.cn: humanistic 与 human 同建于一个拉丁词根之上：humanus、humanity、humanism、humanist，最后是 humanistic。

latinIntro.en: Latin humanus and humanitas give the root sense of human culture, which Renaissance scholars revived as studia humanitatis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 humanus 与 humanitas 给出「人类文化」的词根义，文艺复兴学者复兴为 studia humanitatis。

items.example: Humanus is the adjective behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: humanus 是整个词族背后的形容词。

items.example: Humanitas names the studies of human culture.
items.exampleCN: humanitas 指对人类文化的研究。

items.example: Humanista was a schoolmaster of the classics.
items.exampleCN: humanista 是教授古典的教师。

items.example: Humanist keeps the classical scholar sense.
items.exampleCN: humanist 保留了古典学者的含义。

items.meaning: a belief centred on human values
items.example: Humanism names the movement.
items.exampleCN: humanism 指这一思想运动。

items.meaning: relating to a belief or system
items.meaningCN: 与某种信条或体系相关的词尾
items.example: The suffix -istic changes humanist into humanistic.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -istic 把 humanist 变成 humanistic。

items.meaningCN: 表示主义或体系的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ism forms humanism.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ism 构成 humanism。

items.meaning: a person who holds a belief
items.meaningCN: 表示信众或从业者的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ist forms humanist.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ist 构成 humanist。

items.example: The humanities remain central to humanistic education.
items.exampleCN: the humanities 仍是人文主义教育的核心。

definition_zh: 人道主义的；慈善的；（名词）人道主义者；慈善家
definition_en: concerned with reducing human suffering and improving the welfare of people, especially in emergencies
core_image: 一只递过水和毯子的手，伸向废墟中受困的人
scene: 洪水退去后，路边搭起白色帐篷，志愿者把热粥分给受损的人家。The humanitarian team set up shelter for families who had lost their homes.
sceneCN: 这里 humanitarian 是「人道主义的、以救助受苦者为目的的」（第 1 个义项：关注减少人类苦难的组织、工作或行动）；句意：人道救援队为失去家园的家庭搭建了住所。画面焦点：白色帐篷、分发热粥的手、写着援助字样的箱子。

pos.zh: 人道主义的；慈善的；以救助他人为目的的
人道主义者；慈善家；慈善事业工作者

derivatives.zh: 博爱主义；人道主义
人类；人性；人道
以人道主义的方式

senses.title: Reducing human suffering
senses.titleCN: 人道主义的；以救济为宗旨的
senses.definition: aiming to protect people from hunger, illness, and danger, often in war or disaster
senses.definitionCN: 旨在保护人们免于饥饿、疾病与危险，常用于战争或灾难情境
senses.example: Aid agencies issued an appeal for humanitarian access to the besieged town.
senses.exampleCN: 援助机构呼吁让人道救援进入这座被围困的城镇。
senses.why: The word began as the belief that every person has equal worth, so the first sense is active protection of that worth in emergencies.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原本表达「人人平等」的信念，因此第一个义项是在危机中为这份价值付诸行动。

senses.title: Devoted to the welfare of all people
senses.definition: acting from a general love of people, through charity or social reform
senses.definitionCN: 出于对人的普遍关爱，通过慈善或社会改革去行动
senses.example: She spent her fortune on humanitarian projects in rural schools.
senses.exampleCN: 她把财产用在乡村学校的慈善项目上。
senses.why: The older face of the word is the philanthropist who thinks in terms of human welfare as a whole, not one disaster at a time.
senses.whyCN: 这个词更早的面貌是慈善家：他从「全人类福祉」出发，而不是一次只应对一场灾难。

senses.title: A person who gives aid
senses.titleCN: 人道主义者；援助工作者
senses.definition: a person who works to improve human welfare, especially through relief work
senses.definitionCN: 为改善人类福祉而工作的人，尤指从事救济工作的人
senses.example: Several humanitarians stayed in the city after the ceasefire collapsed.
senses.exampleCN: 停火破裂后，仍有几位人道主义者留在城中。
senses.why: The concrete noun simply names the person behind the adjective, matching the -arian pattern that also gives librarian.
senses.whyCN: 名词义项直接指形容词背后的人，符合 -arian 这种构词，正如 librarian 指图书管理员。

intro.en: Humanitarian spreads from the idea of a universal love of humanity, fashionable in English theology of the 19th century.
intro.cn: humanitarian 源出「普遍博爱」的观念，这种说法在十九世纪的英语神学中颇为流行。

items.en: Humanus and humanitas tie the word to human nature, culture, and benevolence.
items.cn: humanus 与 humanitas 把这个词同人性、文化与善意连在一起。

items.en: Humain and humanité carry the optimistic idea that people deserve help as people.
items.cn: 法语 humain 与 humanité 承载着「人本身值得被帮助」的乐观观念。

items.en: Humanitarian appears first among writers and preachers as a term for those who stress the love of humanity.
items.cn: 十九世纪 humanitarian 先在作家与牧师中出现，用来称呼强调博爱之人。

items.en: The sense shifts with relief work, and the word begins to mean the person who gives aid.
items.cn: 随着救济事务的兴起，词义转移，开始指提供援助的人。

items.en: After the wars of the 20th century humanitarian names the principles and agencies that protect civilians.
items.cn: 二十世纪的战争之后，humanitarian 指保护平民的原则与机构。

items.en: Modern use is mostly the adjective before aid, crisis, and law.
items.cn: 现代用法多为形容词，常置于 aid、crisis 与 law 之前。

note.en: Humanitarian sits in the human family but is about action: it names the work of lifting suffering, not a general kind mood.
note.cn: humanitarian 虽属 human 家族，却指向行动：它命名的是减轻苦难的工作，而非一般的善心。

entries.definition: the principle of helping all people
the human race; compassion
literature, history, and philosophy
giving help to those in need
giving money and help for public good
a person who gives to good causes

normalIntro.en: Humanitarian ends in -arian, the ending of people and of their beliefs: librarian, vegetarian, humanitarian.
normalIntro.cn: humanitarian 以 -arian 结尾，这个结尾既指人又指信条：librarian、vegetarian、humanitarian 都是如此。

normal.en: The -arian ending marks a person or a supporter of a cause, as in vegetarian.
normal.cn: 词尾 -arian 标记一种人或支持某项事业者，如同 vegetarian。

normal.en: The base humanity gives the idea of the whole human race, which the aid sense builds on.
normal.cn: 词基 humanity 给出「全人类」的观念，救济义正是在此之上生长。

normal.en: The fixed collocation is humanitarian aid, used for rescue in wars and disasters.
normal.cn: 固定搭配 humanitarian aid 用于战争与灾害中的救援。

normal.en: humanitarian law is the body of rules protecting people in conflict.
normal.cn: humanitarian law 是冲突中保护人的规则体系。

normal.en: Compare charitable and humanitarian: charitable involves money, humanitarian involves action that reduces suffering.
normal.cn: 对比 charitable 与 humanitarian：前者重在出钱，后者重在减少痛苦的行动。

abstract.en: Picture a hand passing a blanket over a broken wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手越过断墙，递出一条毯子。

abstract.en: Think of a white tent standing alone where a town used to be.
abstract.cn: 想象在原本是城镇的地方，孤零零立着一顶白帐篷。

abstract.en: Imagine the word human with aching feet and a bag of food.
abstract.cn: 想象 human 这个词磨破了脚，背着一袋食物。

examples.en: The government allowed a humanitarian corridor for civilians to leave the city.
examples.cn: 政府开放了一条人道走廊，让平民离开这座城。

examples.en: Humanitarian groups warn that clean water is running out in the camps.
examples.cn: 人道组织警告说，营地里的洁净水即将用完。

examples.en: He was a quiet humanitarian who funded clinics in three countries.
examples.cn: 他是一位低调的人道主义者，出资在三个国家建了诊所。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休曼尼特瑞安」——休整、曼妙、尼特、瑞安，像一支跑来救济的队伍；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 humanus（人的）→ humanitas（人性、仁慈）→ 英语 humanity → humanity 加 -arian（表示人或信奉者）构成 humanitarian，先指主张博爱之人，后指救济工作与援助者。

sensesIntro.en: Humanitarian moves from belief to person to practice: a lover of humanity, then the person, then the work of relief.
sensesIntro.cn: humanitarian 从信念到人再到实践：先指博爱者，再指那个人，最后指救济工作本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand passing water and a blanket over a broken wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手越过断墙，递过水和一条毯子。

branches.en: Relief in emergencies is the dominant modern sense.
branches.cn: 紧急救济是现代最主要的义项。

branches.en: Broad charity of spirit is the older background sense.
branches.cn: 广义的博爱是更早的背景义项。

branches.en: The person sense names the helper directly.
branches.cn: 人或工作者义项直接指提供帮助的人。

branches.en: Aid workers and aid agencies share the same goal of stopping suffering.
branches.cn: 援助工作者与援助机构有着同一个目标：终止苦难。

branches.en: The philanthropist and the relief worker both act on a love of humanity.
branches.cn: 慈善家与救援人员都出于对人的关爱而行动。

intro.en: Humanitarian is human plus humanity plus the -arian ending that names people and their causes, the same ending as librarian.
intro.cn: humanitarian 由 human、humanity 与 -arian 组成；-arian 用来指人和所信奉的事业，与 librarian 同构。

latinIntro.en: Latin humanus and humanitas mean of a human and human nature, the root of humanity and humanitarianism alike.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 humanus 与 humanitas 意为「人的」与「人性」，是 humanity 与 humanitarianism 共同的根源。

items.example: Humanus feeds the whole family.
items.exampleCN: humanus 滋养整个词族。

items.example: Humanitas gives the idea of human worth.
items.exampleCN: humanitas 给出「人的价值」这一观念。

items.example: Humanity is the base of the longer word.
items.exampleCN: humanity 是较长单词的词基。

items.example: The suffix -arian forms humanitarian.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -arian 构成 humanitarian。

items.meaningCN: 表示主义或体系的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ism forms humanitarianism.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ism 构成 humanitarianism。

items.meaning: the principle of helping all people
items.example: Humanitarianism names the principle behind aid.
items.exampleCN: humanitarianism 命名援助背后的原则。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms the rare adverb humanitarianly.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ly 构成少用的副词 humanitarianly。

items.meaning: in a way that helps people
items.example: Aid was delivered humanitarianly and without regard to sides.
items.exampleCN: 救援以人道主义的方式送达，不分阵营。

items.example: Humanistic is the sister word about learning, not aid.
items.exampleCN: humanistic 是姐妹词，重在学问而非援助。

definition_zh: 谦逊；谦卑；恭顺；朴实无华
definition_en: the quality of not believing you are better than other people, and of accepting your own limits
core_image: 头微微低下去：一个人把自己的位置放低，好看见别人
scene: 老教授讲完课，认真记下学生提出的不同意见。The old professor noted down his students opposite views without losing humility.
sceneCN: 这里 humility 是「谦逊」（第 1 个义项：不觉得自己高人一等，愿意承认自己的界限）；句意：老教授把学生提出的相反看法认真记了下来，丝毫不失谦逊。

pos.zh: 谦逊；谦卑
恭顺；卑下（古义）

forms.label: 不可数名词，通常不用复数

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁词根 humilis 直接进入英语，义为「谦逊的、地位低的」
humble 加副词后缀 -ly，义为「谦恭地」
同源动词，义为「羞辱」，把对方压到最低处
humiliate 加名词后缀 -ion，义为「羞辱；屈辱」

senses.title: The quality of not thinking too highly of yourself
senses.definition: the quality of believing you are not more important or better than other people
senses.definitionCN: 不认为自己比别人更重要或更优秀的品质
senses.example: She accepted the prize with quiet humility.
senses.exampleCN: 她带着平静的谦逊接受了这个奖。
senses.why: Latin humilis means low or on the ground, so humility is a mind that keeps itself low without losing dignity.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 humilis 意为「低的、贴近地面的」，所以谦逊是把自己放低却不失尊严的一种心态。

senses.title: Willingness to admit limits and error
senses.titleCN: 能承认自己不足的谦逊
senses.definition: a readiness to admit that you may be wrong or that you do not know something
senses.definitionCN: 愿意承认自己可能出错或有所不知的态度
senses.example: Good scientists combine curiosity with humility.
senses.exampleCN: 优秀的科学家把好奇心与谦逊结合在一起。
senses.why: Once the mind is low, it can be corrected, so humility grows into an honest awareness of ones own limits.
senses.whyCN: 心一旦放低就能被修正，于是谦逊进一步长成对自身局限的诚实认识。

senses.title: Low rank or lowly condition
senses.definition: a humble rank or lowly condition in the old sense of the word
senses.definitionCN: 旧义中指低微的等级或卑下的处境
senses.example: He rose from the humility of a farm boy to a judge.
senses.exampleCN: 他从农场少年卑微的出身一路做到法官。
senses.why: The earliest use named social lowliness, and only later did the word move to the inner virtue.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最早指社会地位的低微，后来才转向内心的美德。

senses.title: Dignified courtesy in speech and manner
senses.definition: a modest, unassuming manner in dealing with other people
senses.definitionCN: 待人接物时低调、不摆架子的态度
senses.example: The director spoke to the cleaners with the same humility.
senses.exampleCN: 这位主任对清洁工说话时也是同样的谦和。
senses.why: The inner virtue shows on the surface as plain courtesy, the daily face of humility.
senses.whyCN: 内在的美德会表现在外表上，成为朴素的礼貌，这就是谦逊的日常面貌。

intro.en: Humility comes through Old French from Latin humilitas, a noun built on humilis, low, from humus, earth or ground.
intro.cn: humility 经古法语来自拉丁语 humilitas，这个词由 humilis（低的）构成，而 humilis 又源于 humus（土地、地面）。

items.en: Humus means earth or ground, the lowest point underfoot.
items.cn: humus 意为土地或地面，是脚下最低的地方。

items.en: Humilis means low, slight, or of low rank.
items.cn: humilis 意为低的、微不足道的或地位低微的。

items.en: Humilitas names lowliness of condition or of mind.
items.cn: humilitas 指处境低微或心性低卑。

items.en: Humilite carries the word into French with a moral sense.
items.cn: humilite 带着道德含义把这个词带入法语。

items.en: Humilite appears in English religious writing.
items.cn: humilite 在中古英语的宗教文本中出现。

items.en: Modern spelling settles as humility, a virtue rather than a rank.
items.cn: 现代拼写定型为 humility，主要是一种美德而非等级。

note.en: Humility belongs to the hum- family of low ground words, and sits near modesty and meekness.
note.cn: humility 属于表示「低处」的 hum- 词族，意义上靠近 modesty 与 meekness。

entries.definition: having a low opinion of your own importance
to make someone look foolish or low
dark organic matter in soil
entries.definitionCN: 腐殖土：与 humility 共享「土地」词根

entries.definition: the habit of not talking proudly about yourself
a gentle, patient and submissive manner
an attitude of superiority over others

normalIntro.en: Humility is the head bent down to the ground, from Latin humus, the earth under your feet.
normalIntro.cn: humility 是低向地面的头，来自拉丁语 humus，即脚下的土地。

normal.en: Latin humus means earth, and humilis means low, so humility is a mind kept close to the ground.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 humus 意为土地，humilis 意为低的，所以谦逊就是贴近地面的心。

normal.en: The adjective humble is the everyday relative: to be humble is to have humility.
normal.cn: 形容词 humble 是它的日常亲戚：humble 的人就拥有 humility。

normal.en: Humiliate uses the same root but pushes someone down; humility is the choice to lower yourself.
normal.cn: humiliate 用同一词根却把别人压下去；humility 则是主动把自己放低。

normal.en: The phrase with humility marks the manner of speaking or acting.
normal.cn: 搭配 with humility 用来标记说话或做事的态度。

normal.en: Compare pride: pride lifts up, humility sets down.
normal.cn: 对比 pride：pride 是抬高自己，humility 是把自己放低。

abstract.en: Picture an old scholar asking a first year student to explain again.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老学者请大一新生再解释一遍。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand raised not to show off but to admit not knowing.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手举起来不是炫耀，而是承认不知道。

abstract.en: Think of a tall tree that bends its branches under heavy fruit.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵高树，果实沉重时枝条就弯了下来。

examples.en: He spoke with genuine humility about his own mistakes.
examples.cn: 他真诚而谦逊地谈起自己的错误。

examples.en: The award taught her humility rather than pride.
examples.cn: 这个奖项教会她的是谦逊而不是骄傲。

examples.en: Real humility means you can still be corrected.
examples.cn: 真正的谦逊意味着你仍然听得进纠正。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休密了提」——把锋芒收起来、不再炫耀的那个「低调」，就是谦逊；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 humus（土地、地面）→ humilis（低的）→ humilitas（低微；谦卑）→ 古法语 humilite → 英语 humility，核心义「把自己放得贴近地面」。

sensesIntro.en: Humility begins as social lowliness, becomes the virtue of a low opinion of yourself, then widens into honest self knowledge and plain courtesy.
sensesIntro.cn: humility 最初指社会地位低微，继而成了一种把自己看得很低的美德，再扩展为诚实的自我认识与朴素的谦和。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a head bent down toward the earth.
core.cn: 核心意象：低向大地的头。

branches.en: The central sense is the virtue of thinking little of yourself.
branches.cn: 中心义项是不高看自己的美德。

branches.en: Admitting limits is humility turned toward learning.
branches.cn: 承认不足是转向学习的谦逊。

branches.en: The old social sense keeps the literal image of low place.
branches.cn: 旧的社会义项保留了「低处」的字面意象。

branches.en: Courtesy is humility made visible in daily manners.
branches.cn: 谦和礼让是谦逊在日常举止中的可见形态。

branches.en: Both the virtue and the admission of error rest on the same low self placement.
branches.cn: 美德与认错都建立在同一个「把自己放低」的动作上。

intro.en: Humility is built on the Latin base hum-, ground, with English humble, humble as an adjective, and humiliate as its harsher relative.
intro.cn: humility 建立在拉丁词基 hum-（土地）之上，英语中还有 humble 与更严厉的同源词 humiliate。

latinIntro.en: Latin humus is earth, humilis is low, and humilitas is the noun lowliness.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 humus 是土地，humilis 是低的，humilitas 是表示「低微」的名词。

items.example: Humus supplies the image of the lowest point.
items.exampleCN: humus 提供了最低处的意象。

items.example: Humilis adds the sense of a low rank or mood.
items.exampleCN: humilis 增加了地位或心气低微的含义。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -itas turns humilis into humilitas.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -itas 把 humilis 变成 humilitas。

items.example: Humilitas is the direct ancestor of the word.
items.exampleCN: humilitas 是本词的直接祖先。

items.example: Humble is the adjective most often paired with it.
items.exampleCN: humble 是最常与它配对的形容词。

items.example: The suffix -ly turns humble into the adverb humbly.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 把 humble 变成副词 humbly。

items.meaning: to lower someone in front of others
items.example: Humiliate takes the same low root but acts on others.
items.exampleCN: humiliate 同样来自「低」的词根，但作用于别人。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms the noun humiliation.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 构成名词 humiliation。

items.example: Humility keeps the full Latin shape.
items.exampleCN: humility 保留了完整的拉丁词形。

definition_zh: 障碍；难关；跨栏；跳栏；跨栏赛跑；跨越障碍
definition_en: a frame or fence that a runner jumps over, or a difficulty that has to be overcome
core_image: 跑道上一排白色矮栏：你必须抬腿跳过去，才到下一段直道
scene: 学期末的经费申请迟迟没有批下来，团队只好先找别的门路。The delay in funding has become the main hurdle for the project.
sceneCN: 这里 hurdle 是「障碍、难关」（第 2 个义项：必须克服的困难）；句意：经费迟迟不到，成了这个项目最主要的障碍。

pos.zh: 障碍；难关
跨栏；跳栏
跨栏赛跑
跨越障碍；克服困难

derivatives.zh: hurdle 加表示「人」的后缀 -er，义为「跨栏运动员」
hurdle 加 -ing，义为「跨栏运动」
hurdle 与 rate 组成的复合词，金融中指「最低预期回报率」

senses.title: A frame that runners jump over
senses.definition: a light frame that athletes jump over in a race
senses.definitionCN: 田径赛中运动员需要跳过的轻便栏架
senses.example: She knocked the last hurdle down.
senses.exampleCN: 她撞倒了最后一个栏架。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical, an object standing in the path that has to be cleared by a jump.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是实物的：路上立着一个东西，只能跳过去。

senses.title: A difficulty to be overcome
senses.definition: a problem or difficulty that must be solved before progress can be made
senses.definitionCN: 必须先解决才能继续前进的问题或困难
senses.example: Cost remains the biggest hurdle for buyers.
senses.exampleCN: 价格对买家来说仍是最大的障碍。
senses.why: Once a hurdle is any obstacle on a path, a slow market or a missing permit becomes a hurdle too.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「栏」泛指路上的阻碍，市场低迷或手续不全也就都成了栏。

senses.title: The race of jumping over hurdles
senses.definition: a track event in which runners jump over a series of frames
senses.definitionCN: 运动员连续跳过栏架的田径项目
senses.example: He won the two hundred metre hurdles.
senses.exampleCN: 他赢下了两百米跨栏。
senses.why: The object names the event by metonymy, much as sprint names an activity.
senses.whyCN: 用栏架代指项目，是转喻用法，正如用冲刺指代某个比赛项目。

senses.title: To jump over a barrier
senses.definition: to jump over a fence or barrier while running
senses.definitionCN: 奔跑中跳过篱笆或障碍物
senses.example: The horse hurdled the fence without slowing down.
senses.exampleCN: 那匹马没有减速就越过了篱笆。
senses.why: English often turns a noun of action into a verb, so the hurdle becomes the act of hurdling.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把动作名词动词化，于是栏架本身变成了「跨栏」这个动作。

senses.title: A stage test in business and exams
senses.titleCN: （考试或商业中的）门槛；阶段关卡
senses.definition: a fixed level or test that must be passed to move on
senses.definitionCN: 必须达到才能进入下一阶段的固定标准或测试
senses.example: The exam is the first hurdle on the road to a licence.
senses.exampleCN: 这场考试是取得执照路上的第一道关卡。
senses.why: A track has several hurdles in a row, so formal processes borrow the image of successive barriers.
senses.whyCN: 跑道上一连有几道栏，于是考试、审批这类正式流程也借用「一道接一道的栏」这个画面。

intro.en: Hurdle comes from Old English hyrdel, a woven fence, and shares its root with the words for hurdle in Dutch and German.
intro.cn: hurdle 来自古英语 hyrdel（编成的篱笆），与荷兰语、德语中表示「栏架」的词同源。

items.en: The reconstructed base hurdiz names something woven or plaited, like a wattle fence.
items.cn: 重构词基 hurdiz 指编织而成的东西，如用柳条编的篱笆。

items.en: Hyrdel means a portable frame of woven branches used as a fence.
items.cn: hyrdel 指可搬动的柳条编织栅栏。

items.en: Hurdle shifts meaning to a frame jumped over in games and races.
items.cn: 中古英语的 hurdle 转为指游戏与赛跑中需要跳过的栏架。

items.en: Organised athletics makes the hurdles a standard track event.
items.cn: 近代田径把跨栏固定为标准项目。

items.en: The figurative sense of any obstacle is now the most common.
items.cn: 现代英语中「泛指障碍」的比喻义已经最常用。

note.en: Hurdle is a fence word that became a race word and then a general word for difficulty; watch the look-alike hurtle.
note.cn: hurdle 本来是「篱笆」词，成了比赛词，又引申为泛指困难的词；注意形近的 hurtle。

entries.definition: to move very fast, often dangerously
entries.definitionCN: 猛冲；飞驰（只是拼写相近，词源不同，与「栏」无关）

entries.definition: an athlete who runs hurdles
to crowd closely together
entries.definitionCN: 挤作一团（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: something that blocks progress
entries.definitionCN: 障碍物；阻碍（更正式、更泛指）

entries.definition: a structure or rule that stops movement
a person or thing that delays or slows

normalIntro.en: Hurdle is a woven fence you must jump over, so every hard task looks like one more frame on the track.
normalIntro.cn: hurdle 是你必须跳过去的编织篱笆，于是每个棘手任务都像跑道上的又一道栏。

normal.en: Old English hyrdel was a movable fence of woven branches, a portable wall.
normal.cn: 古英语 hyrdel 是可以搬动的柳条栅栏，一堵能移动的墙。

normal.en: The verb hurdle appears in the noun first and takes an object such as a fence.
normal.cn: 动词 hurdle 由名词转化而来，后面常接 fence 之类的宾语。

normal.en: Pair it with overcome or clear: to clear a hurdle is to get past a difficulty.
normal.cn: 常与 overcome 或 clear 搭配：clear a hurdle 就是度过难关。

normal.en: The -s form hurdles is both plural and third person singular of the verb.
normal.cn: -s 形式的 hurdles 既是复数，也是动词的三单形式。

normal.en: Compare obstacle: obstacle is a general wall, hurdle is one of a series you jump in turn.
normal.cn: 对比 obstacle：obstacle 是泛指的墙，hurdle 是一连几道需要依次跨过的栏。

abstract.en: Picture a white frame on a red track, painted with distance markers.
abstract.cn: 想象红色跑道上的白色栏架，栏上还画着距离标记。

abstract.en: Imagine a permit office where every counter is one more hurdle.
abstract.cn: 想象审批大厅里，每经过一个柜台就是又一道关。

abstract.en: Think of a horse clearing a wooden fence without slowing.
abstract.cn: 想象一匹马不减速就跃过木篱笆。

examples.en: Language barriers remain a hurdle for many new arrivals.
examples.cn: 语言障碍对许多新来者来说仍是一道难关。

examples.en: The company cleared the final hurdle before the launch.
examples.cn: 公司在发布前越过了最后一道难关。

examples.en: He was a national champion in the hurdles before he turned to coaching.
examples.cn: 他在转做教练之前是全国跨栏冠军。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赫兜了」——前面横着一道栏，抬腿「呼」一下就过去了，跨过去才算赢；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 重构词基 hurd-（编织物、篱笆）→ 古英语 hyrdel（可搬动的柳条篱笆）→ 中古英语 hurdle（比赛中要跳过的栏）→ 现代泛指各种障碍。

sensesIntro.en: Hurdle starts as a fence, becomes the frame on a track, takes over the race itself, then widens into any difficulty and any formal test.
sensesIntro.cn: hurdle 起初是篱笆，后来成为跑道上的栏架，又代指跨栏项目，再泛指各种障碍与考试关卡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white frame across the track that must be jumped.
core.cn: 核心意象：横在跑道上的白栏，必须跳过去。

branches.en: The concrete frame on the track is the original sense.
branches.cn: 跑道上的实体栏架是最初的义项。

branches.en: Any obstacle inherits the image of a frame that blocks the path.
branches.cn: 任何障碍都继承了「挡住去路的栏」这一意象。

branches.en: The object gives its name to the race, by metonymy.
branches.cn: 栏架通过转喻把自己名字给了比赛项目。

branches.en: The verb turns the barrier into the act of clearing it.
branches.cn: 动词把栏架变成「跨越」这个动作。

branches.en: A hurdle and a gate are both things you must get past in turn.
branches.cn: 难关与关卡都是必须依次越过的东西。

intro.en: Hurdle is a native Germanic word with no Latin prefix; the family grows by adding -er, -ing and compounding.
intro.cn: hurdle 是日耳曼语源的英语本族词，没有拉丁前缀；词族靠 -er、-ing 和复合来扩展。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin ancestors, so only the Germanic source and the English derivatives are listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语祖先，因此下面只列日耳曼语来源与英语派生形式。

items.example: Hurdiz is a reconstructed form shown with a star.
items.exampleCN: hurdiz 是带星号的重构形式。

items.example: Hyrdel is the first English record of the word.
items.exampleCN: hyrdel 是这个词语最古老的英语记录。

items.example: The ending -le marks the word as a thing.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -le 表明它是一个具体物件。

items.example: Hurdle keeps both the concrete and abstract senses.
items.exampleCN: hurdle 同时保留具体与抽象两种含义。

items.example: The suffix -er forms hurdler.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 hurdler。

items.example: Hurdler names the athlete.
items.exampleCN: hurdler 指跨栏运动员。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms hurdling.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 hurdling。

items.example: Hurdling is now a standard track sport.
items.exampleCN: hurdling 现在是标准的田径项目。

items.example: The verb hurdle means to clear a barrier.
items.exampleCN: 动词 hurdle 表示越过障碍。

definition_zh: 猛扔；用力掷；大声喊出；猛烈抨击
definition_en: to throw something with great force, or to shout angry words
core_image: 手臂抡圆了，把东西用力甩出去
scene: 人群在球场边越喊越凶。Fans hurled empty bottles across the pitch and shouted at the referee.
sceneCN: 这里 hurl 是「猛扔、用力掷」（第 1 个义项：用很大力气把东西扔出去）；句意：球迷把空瓶子猛扔过球场，还对裁判大声叫喊。

pos.zh: 猛扔；用力掷
大声喊出；厉声说出
猛烈抨击

derivatives.zh: hurl 加表示「人」的后缀 -er，义为「投掷者」；也指爱尔兰式曲棍球运动员
hurl 加 -ing，义为「爱尔兰式曲棍球」，也指投掷动作
与 hurling 同指爱尔兰式曲棍球或其球棍的旧称

senses.title: To throw something with great force
senses.definition: to throw a heavy thing with all the strength of the arm
senses.definitionCN: 用尽手臂力气把重物扔出去
senses.example: Protesters hurled stones at the police line.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议者朝警察防线扔石头。
senses.why: The core image is the whole arm swinging, so the verb is about force rather than distance or aim.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是整条手臂抡出去，所以这个动词强调力气，而非距离或准头。

senses.title: To shout words with force
senses.definition: to say words loudly and roughly, as if throwing them at someone
senses.definitionCN: 像把话扔出去一样，粗暴而响亮地说
senses.example: She hurled a question at the witness.
senses.exampleCN: 她朝证人抛出一个问题。
senses.why: Words thrown across a room follow the same flight path as a stone, so shouting becomes hurling.
senses.whyCN: 被扔出去的话和石头走同一条弧线，于是喊叫也就成了 hurling。

senses.title: To attack with words
senses.definition: to criticise someone fiercely in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在言语或文字中猛烈攻击某人
senses.example: Critics hurled abuse at the new policy.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者对新政策破口大骂。
senses.why: When words are seen as weapons, hurling them means attacking, and the verb takes on a moral edge.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把话当成武器，hurl 就成了攻击，动词也带上了道德评判的色彩。

senses.title: To move or fall violently
senses.definition: to send someone or something violently into a place or state
senses.definitionCN: 把某人某物猛烈地送入某种境地
senses.example: The wave hurled the boat against the rocks.
senses.exampleCN: 浪把船猛力拍向岩石。
senses.why: The verb widens from a human thrower to any force that sends things flying.
senses.whyCN: 动作的执行者从人扩大到任何能把东西抛飞的力量。

senses.title: The play of Irish hurling
senses.definition: the name of a fast Irish stick game, from the throwing of the ball
senses.definitionCN: 一种快速的爱尔兰球类运动，名称来自球的投掷动作
senses.example: Hurling is older than the written records of Ireland.
senses.exampleCN: 爱尔兰式曲棍球比爱尔兰的文字记载还要古老。
senses.why: The game takes its name from hurling the ball, the same arm swing the verb describes.
senses.whyCN: 这项运动因「把球挥出」而得名，正是动词 hurl 描述的抡臂动作。

intro.en: Hurl is probably a word of uncertain origin, appearing in early Middle English; the usual guess is connection with a throwing or roaring root.
intro.cn: hurl 来源不确定，早见于中古英语早期；常见的一种推测认为它与表示「投掷」或「呼吼」的词根有关，但尚无定论。

items.en: No ancestor of hurl is found in Old English; its origin is uncertain.
items.cn: 古英语中没有 hurl 的前身，来源不确定。

items.en: Hurl or hurlen appears meaning to rush or strike violently.
items.cn: 中古英语的 hurl 或 hurlen 出现，意为「猛冲、猛撞」。

items.en: The verb takes on the sense of throwing a thing with force.
items.cn: 这个动词获得「用力投掷某物」的含义。

items.en: Hurling is recorded as the name of an Irish stick game.
items.cn: hurling 作为爱尔兰球类运动名称被记录下来。

items.en: The figurative sense of hurling abuse becomes common in news writing.
items.cn: hurl abuse 这类比喻用法在现代新闻写作中变得常见。

note.en: Hurl is a throw of pure force, close in shape to hurdle and hurtle, and close in meaning to fling and toss.
note.cn: hurl 是纯粹的用力投掷，外形上靠近 hurdle、hurtle，意义上靠近 fling 与 toss。

entries.definition: to move very fast and with force
entries.definitionCN: 猛冲；飞驰（只是拼写相近，词源与基本义都不同）

entries.definition: a frame to jump over or a difficulty
entries.definitionCN: 栏架；障碍（只是拼写相近，来自「篱笆」词根）

entries.definition: to twist into a round shape
entries.definitionCN: 卷曲（押韵的形近词，词源不同）

entries.definition: to throw with force or anger
to throw lightly or carelessly
to throw a ball in a game

normalIntro.en: Hurl is the whole arm swinging: the force of the throw is the meaning, not the grace of it.
normalIntro.cn: hurl 是整条手臂抡出去：意思是那股力气，而不是动作的优美。

normal.en: Hurl pairs naturally with abuse and insults, because words can be thrown like stones.
normal.cn: hurl 天然与 abuse、insults 搭配，因为话语能像石头一样被扔出去。

normal.en: Its regular past is hurled, with a single l before the -ed ending.
normal.cn: 它的规则过去式是 hurled，-ed 前只有一个 l。

normal.en: The noun hurling names the old Irish stick game, where players hurl the ball.
normal.cn: 名词 hurling 指古老的爱尔兰球类运动，球员正是把球抡出去的。

normal.en: The pattern hurl oneself at something means to rush at it.
normal.cn: 搭配 hurl oneself at 表示朝某物猛扑过去。

normal.en: Compare toss: toss is light and careless, hurl is heavy and angry.
normal.cn: 对比 toss：toss 轻而随意，hurl 重而带怒气。

abstract.en: Picture a boy swinging his whole body to throw a stone across a river.
abstract.cn: 想象一个男孩甩动整个身体，把石头扔过河去。

abstract.en: Imagine a coach shouting one word across a field, as if throwing it.
abstract.cn: 想象教练把一句话隔场「扔」向球员。

abstract.en: Think of a storm wave flinging a small boat against black rocks.
abstract.cn: 想象风暴中的浪把小船拍向黑色岩石。

examples.en: He hurled the ball across the field with one arm.
examples.cn: 他单臂把球猛力抛过球场。

examples.en: The crowd hurled insults at the speaker.
examples.cn: 人群对演讲者恶语相向。

examples.en: Angry workers hurled the old machine into the river.
examples.cn: 愤怒的工人把那台旧机器扔进了河里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「喝嚕」一声抡圆胳膊甩出去，手里东西就飞了；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 来源不确定：中古英语 hurl 或 hurlen（激烈冲撞、投掷），一般认为与其表示「呼吼、碰撞」的词族相关，但未定论；核心义「抡臂猛掷」。

sensesIntro.en: Hurl starts with a heavy object thrown by arm power, extends to words shouted at people, to praise or blame as weapons, to any violent force, and finally to an Irish game.
sensesIntro.cn: hurl 从「用臂力扔出重物」出发，延伸到「朝人喊话」，再到把言语当武器来抨击，又扩展到任何猛力冲击，最后落到一项爱尔兰运动的名称上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arm swinging round and letting go.
core.cn: 核心意象：手臂抡圆，然后松手。

branches.en: The physical throw is the root sense.
branches.cn: 实物的投掷是根本义项。

branches.en: Spoken words take the same flight path.
branches.cn: 说出的话走同一条飞行轨迹。

branches.en: Words as weapons make the verb a weapon.
branches.cn: 话成了武器，动词也成了武器。

branches.en: Any force that sends things flying can be the thrower.
branches.cn: 任何能把东西抛飞的力量都可以充当施动者。

branches.en: The Irish game takes its name from the hurl of the ball.
branches.cn: 爱尔兰球类运动的名字来自把球抡出去的动作。

intro.en: Hurl is a short Germanic-looking verb of uncertain origin, so only its English and Irish relatives are listed here.
intro.cn: hurl 是一个来源不确定的短动词，因此这里只列英语与爱尔兰语的亲属形式。

latinIntro.en: No Latin ancestor or Latin cognate can be established for hurl, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: hurl 没有可以确证的拉丁语祖先或同源词，因此拉丁语同源列表留空。

items.example: Hurl is first recorded in early Middle English.
items.exampleCN: hurl 最早见于中古英语早期。

items.example: Hurled keeps the regular -ed ending.
items.exampleCN: hurled 保留规则的 -ed 词尾。

items.example: Hurling is also the name of the game.
items.exampleCN: hurling 也是这项运动的名称。

items.example: The suffix -er forms hurler.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 hurler。

items.example: Hurler is also a hurling player.
items.exampleCN: hurler 也指曲棍球球员。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms hurling.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 hurling。

items.example: Abuse is the most common thing hurled at people.
items.exampleCN: abuse 是人们最常 hurling 的东西。

items.example: Insults are hurled in anger.
items.exampleCN: insults 常被带着怒气扔出去。

items.example: The verb hurl commonly pairs with into.
items.exampleCN: 动词 hurl 常与 into 连用。

definition_zh: 使吸收水分；为身体补充水分；（化学）水合物；使水合
definition_en: to make someone or something take in water, or to combine a substance with water; also a chemical compound that contains water
core_image: 干裂的土地上浇下一杯清水，缝隙被水一点点填满
scene: 长跑比赛结束后，志愿者把水瓶递到选手手里，提醒他先补水。After the race, the volunteer handed a bottle of water to the runner and told her to hydrate first.
sceneCN: 这里 hydrate 是「为身体补充水分」（第 1 个义项：使人或物吸收水分）；句意：赛后志愿者把水瓶递给选手，让她先补水。

pos.zh: 使吸收水分；为身体补充水分；使水合
水合物；含结晶水的化合物

derivatives.zh: 动词加名词后缀 -tion 构成，义为「水合作用；补水」
前缀 de- 表示「去除」+ hydrate，义为「使脱水」
过去分词作形容词，义为「含水的；补足水分的」
前缀 an- 表示「无」+ 希腊语水词根，义为「无水的」
碳（carbo）与水化物（hydrate）组合，义为「碳水化合物」

senses.title: To supply water to a body
senses.definition: to give water to a person, animal, or plant so that it does not become dry
senses.definitionCN: 给人、动物或植物补充水分，使其不至于变得干旱
senses.example: Athletes were told to hydrate before the race.
senses.exampleCN: 运动员被告知要在赛前补充水分。
senses.why: The Greek water root supplies the plain idea of adding water, and in everyday use the object is a living body.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语「水」词根提供「加水」的基本意象；日常用法中，加水的对象是活着的身体，所以这个义项是「给人畜补水」。

senses.title: To make a surface absorb moisture
senses.definition: to make a surface, especially skin or hair, absorb and keep moisture
senses.definitionCN: 使表面（尤其是皮肤或头发）吸收并保持水分
senses.example: This cream is designed to hydrate dry skin.
senses.exampleCN: 这款面霜专门用于给干燥的皮肤补水。
senses.why: The same adding of water is turned towards a surface, so the image shifts from a drinking body to something that soaks water in.
senses.whyCN: 同样是把水加进去，只是对象换成了一种表面，于是画面从「喝水的人」变成「吸水的表层」，皮肤与头发就是这样被滋润的。

senses.title: To combine a substance with water
senses.definition: in chemistry, to combine a substance with water so that water molecules attach to it
senses.definitionCN: 在化学中指使某物质与水结合，让水分子附着其上
senses.example: The salts hydrate quickly when placed in humid air.
senses.exampleCN: 这些盐放在潮湿空气中会很快水合。
senses.why: Chemistry keeps the literal water but makes it a molecular partner, so the verb means water joining a compound.
senses.whyCN: 化学保留了字面上的水，却让水变成分子层面的伙伴；于是这个义项指水与化合物结合，也就是水合。

senses.title: A compound containing water
senses.definition: a chemical compound in which water molecules are combined with another substance in fixed amounts
senses.definitionCN: 水分子以固定比例与另一物质结合的化合物
senses.example: Blue copper sulfate hydrate loses its water when heated.
senses.exampleCN: 蓝色的硫酸铜水合物受热时会失去水分。
senses.why: Turning the verb into a noun names the product of hydrating, so a hydrate is the substance that has taken water into its structure.
senses.whyCN: 把动词变成名词，指的正是「水合之后得到的东西」；既然水已经进入结构，这种物质便被称作水合物。

intro.en: Hydrate combines Greek hydor, water, with the English chemical suffix -ate, and was first used in chemistry before spreading into everyday health talk.
intro.cn: hydrate 由希腊语「水」词根与英语化学后缀 -ate 组合而成，最初用于化学，后来才进入日常健康话题。

items.en: A reconstructed root wed- underlies words for water in several related languages.
items.cn: 一般认为，重构词根 wed- 是多个亲属语言中「水」一词的共同来源。

items.en: Hydor means water, and hydor compounds name water in words like hydria, a water jar.
items.cn: 希腊语 hydor 意为水，hydria 一词用这个词根指「水罐」。

items.en: Nineteenth century chemistry borrows the water root for compounds formed with water.
items.cn: 十九世纪的化学借入这个「水」词根，用来指与水结合形成的化合物。

items.en: The noun hydrate names a water-containing compound, and a verb for making one follows.
items.cn: 名词 hydrate 指含水化合物，随后又衍生出「使水合」的动词用法。

items.en: Health and beauty writing uses hydrate for drinking enough water and keeping skin moist.
items.cn: 当代健康与美容类文章用 hydrate 表示喝足水、保持皮肤湿润。

note.en: Hydrate shares the Greek water root with hydrogen, dehydration, and hydraulic, and sits close to everyday words for taking in water.
note.cn: hydrate 与 hydrogen、dehydration、hydraulic 共享希腊语「水」词根，也与表示「喝水」的普通词相邻。

entries.definition: a light gas that forms water when it burns
entries.definitionCN: 一种轻质气体，燃烧时生成水；与 hydrate 共享「水」词根

entries.definition: to remove water from something
the process of adding water or the state of having enough water
operated by water or another liquid under pressure
to make something slightly wet
to let something stay in water until it is very wet
to fill something up again after it has been used

normalIntro.en: Hydrate is the water root plus a chemical ending: wherever water is added to something, that thing is hydrated.
normalIntro.cn: hydrate 由「水」词根加化学词尾构成：凡是给某物加水，就是把该物水合。

normal.en: The root hydro means water, as in hydrogen and hydraulic.
normal.cn: 词根 hydro 意为水，hydrogen 与 hydraulic 里都有它。

normal.en: The prefix de- reverses it, so dehydrate means to take water away.
normal.cn: 前缀 de- 表示去除，所以 dehydrate 意为脱水。

normal.en: Stay hydrated is the common health advice after exercise.
normal.cn: stay hydrated 是运动后常见的健康提醒。

normal.en: The suffix -tion turns the verb into the noun hydration.
normal.cn: 后缀 -tion 把动词变成名词 hydration。

normal.en: Carbohydrate literally joins carbon with water, which is why sugar and starch are named this way.
normal.cn: carbohydrate 字面意思是碳与水结合，糖和淀粉因此得名。

abstract.en: Picture a long-distance runner tilting a bottle and drinking in slow gulps.
abstract.cn: 想象一名长跑选手仰起水瓶，慢慢大口喝水。

abstract.en: Imagine a sponge slowly turning from light to dark as it takes up water.
abstract.cn: 想象一块海绵吸水后从浅色慢慢变深。

abstract.en: See a blue crystal flake apart and turn white as its water escapes.
abstract.cn: 想象蓝色晶体失去水后松散开来，变成白色细粉。

examples.en: Remember to hydrate during the long walk in the heat.
examples.cn: 在高温下长途步行时记得补充水分。

examples.en: The nurse kept the hydrated gauze pressed on the wound.
examples.cn: 护士把浸湿的纱布一直压在伤口上。

examples.en: Chemists measured how much water the hydrate contains.
examples.cn: 化学家测量了这种水合物含多少水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 hydrate 想成「海喌特」——海里灌水，身体就水汪汪；这只是谐音联想，与希腊语词源无关。

root: 希腊语 hydor（水）→ hydro-（水）→ 英语化学词 hydrate，核心义「加水、含水」。

sensesIntro.en: Hydrate starts as adding water to a living body, moves to moistening a surface, then takes the chemical senses of combining with water and of the compound so formed.
sensesIntro.cn: hydrate 先从给活体加水讲起，再扩展到滋润表面，最后进入化学领域，指与水结合以及结合后得到的化合物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cup of clear water poured onto something dry.
core.cn: 核心意象：一杯清水浇在干燥的东西上。

branches.en: Drinking enough water is the ordinary health sense.
branches.cn: 喝够水是日常健康层面的义项。

branches.en: Moistening skin or hair is the beauty sense.
branches.cn: 给皮肤或头发保湿是美容层面的义项。

branches.en: Water joining a molecule is the chemical verb sense.
branches.cn: 水与分子结合是化学动词义项。

branches.en: The substance that holds the water is the noun sense.
branches.cn: 把水留在结构里的物质就是名词义项。

branches.en: The health use and the chemical use share the same act of adding water.
branches.cn: 健康用法与化学用法共享同一个「加水」动作。

intro.en: Hydrate is built from the Greek water root, the chemical suffix -ate, and a family of compounds such as dehydrate and carbohydrate.
intro.cn: hydrate 由希腊语「水」词根与化学后缀 -ate 搭成，周围还有 dehydrate、carbohydrate 等同词族。

latinIntro.en: The root is Greek rather than Latin: hydor means water, and many technical words still carry it.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根来自希腊语而非拉丁语：hydor 意为水，许多技术词至今仍带着它。

items.example: The root hydr- opens the word hydrate.
items.exampleCN: 词根 hydr- 是 hydrate 的开头。

items.meaning: a compound formed with a substance
items.meaningCN: 与某物质结合而成的化合物
items.example: The suffix -ate marks a chemical compound.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ate 标记一种化合物。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或状态的名词词尾
items.example: The suffix -tion forms hydration.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -tion 构成 hydration。

items.example: The prefix de- forms dehydrate.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 de- 构成 dehydrate。

items.example: The prefix an- forms anhydrous.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 an- 构成 anhydrous。

items.meaning: the process of taking in water
items.example: Hydration keeps the body working well.
items.exampleCN: 补水让身体运转良好。

items.example: Dehydrate means the opposite of hydrate.
items.exampleCN: dehydrate 与 hydrate 意义相反。

items.example: Anhydrous salts have lost their water.
items.exampleCN: 无水盐已经失去了水。

items.example: Carbohydrate joins carbon with hydrate.
items.exampleCN: carbohydrate 把碳与含水物组合在一起。

items.example: The prefix hydro- forms hydrology.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 hydro- 构成 hydrology。

definition_zh: 烃；碳氢化合物
definition_en: a chemical compound made only of the elements hydrogen and carbon, such as oil, gas, and petrol
core_image: 一串碳原子手拉手连成骨架，氢原子像小珠子一样挂满四周
scene: 油轮在海上航行，货舱里装满了从地下开采出的黑色液体与气体。The tanker was carrying hydrocarbon products from the offshore field to the refinery.
sceneCN: 这里 hydrocarbon 是「烃、碳氢化合物」（第 1 个义项：只由氢和碳组成的化合物）；句意：这艘油轮把海上油田产出的碳氢化合物产品运往炼油厂。

pos.zh: 烃；碳氢化合物

derivatives.zh: 由 hydrocarbon 与 cracker（裂解装置）构成，义为「加氢裂化装置」
由 hydrogen 加 -ate 与过去分词词尾构成，义为「氢化的」
由 petro-（岩石、石油）与 chemical 构成，义为「石油化工产品」，常指烃的下游产品

senses.title: A compound of only carbon and hydrogen
senses.definition: a compound whose molecules contain only carbon atoms and hydrogen atoms
senses.definitionCN: 分子中只含碳原子和氢原子的化合物
senses.example: Methane is the simplest hydrocarbon.
senses.exampleCN: 甲烷是最简单的烃。
senses.why: The name spells out its two ingredients, carbon and hydrogen, so the word labels a whole family of compounds by what they contain.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本身就是把两种元素的名字拼在一起；既然分子里只有碳和氢，整个化合物家族便都以此命名。

senses.title: Fuel derived from oil and gas
senses.definition: the oil and gas fuels, or the products made from them, that power vehicles and industry
senses.definitionCN: 石油与天然气等烃类燃料，或其加工产品，用于驱动车辆和工业
senses.example: Carbon taxes raise the price of hydrocarbon fuels.
senses.exampleCN: 碳税提高了碳氢燃料的价格。
senses.why: Most of the fuels people burn are hydrocarbons, so the chemical name came to stand for the fuel itself.
senses.whyCN: 人们燃烧的燃料大多是烃；于是这个化学名词逐渐直接指代燃料本身，成为能源话题中的常用说法。

senses.title: The source of pollution and climate worries
senses.definition: the emissions and pollution caused by burning or leaking hydrocarbons
senses.definitionCN: 燃烧或泄漏烃类造成的排放与污染
senses.example: Unburnt hydrocarbons react in sunlight to form smog.
senses.exampleCN: 未燃烧的烃类在阳光下反应，形成烟雾。
senses.why: When the fuel burns imperfectly or leaks, the hydrocarbons become pollutants, so the same word also names a climate and air quality problem.
senses.whyCN: 燃料燃烧不完全或发生泄漏时，烃就变成了污染物；于是同一个词又成为气候变化与空气质量的议题词。

intro.en: Hydrocarbon is an English compound word, joining the Greek water root in hydrogen with Latin carbo, coal or charcoal, for the element carbon.
intro.cn: hydrocarbon 是英语自身组合的复合词：希腊语「水」词根构成 hydrogen，拉丁语 carbo（煤、炭）构成 carbon，两个元素名合在一起。

items.en: Carbo means coal or charcoal.
items.cn: 拉丁语 carbo 意为煤或木炭。

items.en: French chemists adopt carbone for the element carbon.
items.cn: 十八世纪法国化学家采用 carbone 称呼碳元素。

items.en: The element name hydrogen is coined from the Greek water-forming root.
items.cn: 元素名 hydrogen 由希腊语「生成水」的词根定名。

items.en: The compound hydrocarbon is coined in chemical writing for substances made of these two elements.
items.cn: 十九世纪化学文献把两个元素名合成为一个英文复合词 hydrocarbon，用来指由此二元素组成的物质。

items.en: The word widens from laboratory chemistry to fuels, industry, and the environment.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词从实验室化学扩展到燃料、工业与环境议题。

note.en: Hydrocarbon is a transparent compound of two element names, so it looks like hydrogen and carbohydrate but means something different from either.
note.cn: hydrocarbon 由两个元素名直接拼成，因此与 hydrogen、carbohydrate 外形相近，但含义各不相同。

entries.definition: a light gas, one of the two elements in a hydrocarbon
entries.definitionCN: 一种轻质气体，是烃的两种组成元素之一

entries.definition: the element found in coal, diamond, and all living things
entries.definitionCN: 存在于煤、钻石和所有生物体中的元素

entries.definition: a sugar or starch containing carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen
entries.definitionCN: 含碳、氢、氧的糖或淀粉；只是构词相近，与 hydrocarbon 不同

entries.definition: using water power to make electricity
coal, oil, or gas formed from ancient living matter
entries.definitionCN: 化石燃料：由远古生物遗骸形成的煤、石油或天然气

entries.definition: a substance formed from two or more elements
entries.definitionCN: 由两种或多种元素组成的化合物

entries.definition: thick dark oil found underground and refined into fuels
entries.definitionCN: 石油；地下开采的深色稠油

normalIntro.en: Hydrocarbon simply names its own two ingredients, so the word never needs a separate translation once the two element names are known.
normalIntro.cn: hydrocarbon 把两种组成元素直接写进名字里，只要认识这两个元素名，词义便一目了然。

normal.en: Hydro comes from the Greek word for water, and carbon comes from Latin coal.
normal.cn: hydro 来自希腊语「水」，carbon 来自拉丁语「煤」。

normal.en: Carbon is the backbone: one carbon atom can join four hydrogen atoms.
normal.cn: 碳是骨架：一个碳原子最多可连接四个氢原子。

normal.en: Aromatic hydrocarbons like benzene smell strongly, although the name refers to their ring structure.
normal.cn: 苯这类芳香烃气味强烈，不过这个名称指的是它们的环状结构。

normal.en: Chlorinated hydrocarbons are used as solvents and as pesticides.
normal.cn: 氯化烃被用作溶剂和杀虫剂。

normal.en: Compare carbohydrate: a carbohydrate also contains oxygen, while a hydrocarbon never does.
normal.cn: 对比 carbohydrate：碳水化合物还含有氧，而烃完全不含氧。

abstract.en: See a long chain of dark carbon beads with tiny hydrogen dots hanging from every bead.
abstract.cn: 想象一串深色碳珠，每颗珠子上都挂着细小的氢点。

abstract.en: Picture a black liquid pouring from a steel pipe into a tank as a flare lights the sky.
abstract.cn: 想象黑色液体从钢管里流进储罐，远处火炬照亮天空。

abstract.en: Think of grey city air that looks oily and smells of petrol.
abstract.cn: 想象城市上空泛着油光、带有汽油味的灰烟。

examples.en: Petrol and natural gas are both hydrocarbons.
examples.cn: 汽油和天然气都是烃。

examples.en: The company cut hydrocarbon emissions by a third.
examples.cn: 这家公司把烃类排放削减了三分之一。

examples.en: Bacteria in the seabed can break down complex hydrocarbons.
examples.cn: 海底细菌能分解复杂的烃类。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「氢-碳-帮」——氢和碳结成帮派，就是烃；这只是拆分联想，不要把谐音当成词源。

root: 希腊语 hydor（水）→ hydrogen（氢）+ 拉丁语 carbo（煤）→ carbon（碳）→ 英语合成词 hydrocarbon，核心义「只含氢与碳的物质」。

sensesIntro.en: Hydrocarbon begins as a chemical definition, then extends to the fuels made of such compounds and finally to the pollution they cause.
sensesIntro.cn: hydrocarbon 先是一个化学定义，随后指代由这类化合物制成的燃料，最后延伸到它们造成的污染。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a carbon chain with hydrogen beads hanging from it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条碳链，挂满氢原子小珠。

branches.en: The chemical definition is the base sense.
branches.cn: 化学定义是基础义项。

branches.en: Fuels made of hydrocarbons are the energy sense.
branches.cn: 由烃制成的燃料是能源义项。

branches.en: Leaking or burning hydrocarbons produces pollution.
branches.cn: 泄漏或燃烧烃会产生污染，这是环境义项。

branches.en: The fuel sense rests on the chemical sense, because oil and gas are hydrocarbons.
branches.cn: 燃料义项建立在化学义项之上，因为石油与天然气本身就是烃。

branches.en: Using hydrocarbon fuels is what creates hydrocarbon emissions.
branches.cn: 使用烃类燃料正是造成烃类排放的原因。

intro.en: Hydrocarbon is a compound of two element names, with hydro-, -carb-, and the combining form -on appearing across chemistry.
intro.cn: hydrocarbon 由两个元素名复合并成，hydro-、-carb- 与 -on 等构词成分在化学词汇中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: The parts come from both Greek and Latin: hydor is Greek water, carbo is Latin coal, and the -on ending follows standard element-name patterns.
latinIntro.cn: 构词成分一半来自希腊语、一半来自拉丁语：hydor 是希腊语的水，carbo 是拉丁语的煤，-on 词尾沿用元素命名的惯例。

items.example: The prefix hydro- appears in hydrogen.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 hydro- 出现在 hydrogen 中。

items.example: The form -carbon- comes from Latin carbo.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 -carbon- 来自拉丁语 carbo。

items.meaningCN: 表示元素或惰性气体的词尾
items.example: The suffix -on marks names like carbon and neon.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -on 标记 carbon、neon 等元素名。

items.example: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
items.exampleCN: 氢是最轻的元素。

items.example: Carbon forms the backbone of organic molecules.
items.exampleCN: 碳构成有机分子的骨架。

items.example: The suffix -ation forms hydrogenation.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ation 构成 hydrogenation。

items.example: Hydrogenation turns liquid oil into solid fat.
items.exampleCN: 氢化作用把液体油变成固体脂肪。

items.meaning: a compound of carbon and hydrogen
items.example: Hydrocarbon is a transparent compound of two names.
items.exampleCN: hydrocarbon 是两个名称合成的复合词。

items.example: The prefix petro- appears in petroleum.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 petro- 出现在 petroleum 中。

definition_zh: 水暖的；利用热水或冷水循环供暖或制冷的
definition_en: using water or another liquid, moved through pipes, to heat or cool a building
core_image: 热水在地板下的细管中一圈圈流动，把热量均匀地铺满整个房间
scene: 冬天清晨，屋主无法把暖气调到合适温度，于是请来维修工查看管路系统。The homeowner called a plumber because the hydronic system could not keep the old house warm.
sceneCN: 这里 hydronic 是「水暖的、靠循环热水供热的」（第 1 个义项：用循环水供暖的系统）；句意：屋主叫来水管工，因为这套水暖系统无法让老房子保持温暖。

pos.zh: 水暖的；水循环供暖或制冷的

derivatives.zh: 形容词去掉词尾 -ic 作名词，义为「水暖技术；液体循环采暖技术」
由 hydronic 加 -ian（从事者）构成，义为「水暖技工」，多见于北美行业用语
与水暖共享希腊语「水」词根，义为「水力学」，属于相邻技术领域

senses.title: Heated by circulating water
senses.titleCN: 水暖的；靠循环热水供暖的
senses.definition: describing a heating system that moves hot water through pipes to warm a building
senses.definitionCN: 形容一种把热水送入管道来为建筑供暖的系统
senses.example: A hydronic system keeps every room at an even temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 水暖系统能让每个房间保持均匀的温度。
senses.why: The Greek water root plus the technical -ic ending marks anything driven by moving water, here specifically hot water used for comfort.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语「水」词根加上技术性词尾 -ic，表示由流动的水驱动；具体到居住舒适，这流动的水就是用来供暖的热水。

senses.title: Cooled by circulating water
senses.definition: describing a cooling system that uses chilled water rather than air to remove heat
senses.definitionCN: 形容一种用冷冻水而非空气来带走热量的制冷系统
senses.example: The new offices rely on hydronic cooling in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 新办公室在夏季依靠水循环制冷。
senses.why: The same water loop can carry heat away instead of bringing it in, so the adjective widens from heating to cooling.
senses.whyCN: 同一套水路既能送热也能带走热量，于是这个形容词从供暖扩展到制冷，描述的是靠循环水降温的系统。

senses.title: The trade and technology of water-based heating
senses.definition: used as a field name for the design and installation of water-based heating and cooling systems
senses.definitionCN: 用作行业名称，指以水为介质的供暖与制冷系统的设计与安装
senses.example: He trained in hydronics before joining the heating firm.
senses.exampleCN: 他在加入这家供暖公司之前学过水暖技术。
senses.why: When the adjective becomes a noun, it names not one installation but the whole craft, because the trade deals with water loops every day.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转成名词后，指的不再是一套装置，而是整个手艺与行业；因为这一行每天打交道的正是水路循环。

intro.en: Hydronic is a twentieth century technical coinage: the Greek water root hydr- joined to an -ic adjective ending, modelled on older words like electronic and hydraulic.
intro.cn: hydronic 是二十世纪的技术新造词：希腊语「水」词根 hydr- 加形容词词尾 -ic，仿照 electronic、hydraulic 等旧词的构型。

items.en: Hydor means water, and hydor compounds name water vessels and water works.
items.cn: 希腊语 hydor 意为水，以它为词根的复合词多指水容器与水工程。

items.en: Latin takes hydr- into words such as hydraulicus, from the Greek water organ.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 hydr- 词根，形成 hydraulicus 等词，源出希腊语水力琴。
